courses.title: Online counselling course
courses.subtitle: A short certification for counsellors: guide a learner from first enquiry to an informed admission decision, using verified facts and needs-based counselling instead of a sales script.
highlights: Explain Online, ODL/Distance and Regular education and the Four-Quadrant model.
Verify programme entitlement for an academic session, and tell recognition, accreditation and ranking apart.
Describe a programme and its syllabus in terms of the learner's goal.
Profile a learner and identify their needs before recommending a programme.
Compare universities on identical parameters and demonstrate the LMS.
Explain total fees, payment options, admission steps and documents.

courses.title: Applied SQL for analytics
courses.subtitle: Write clear, correct SQL to answer real business questions, from simple filters to window functions.
highlights: Explain the logical order in which a SQL query is evaluated
Filter, sort and aggregate data, handling NULL values correctly
Combine tables with inner, left and anti joins without duplicating rows
Structure long queries with common table expressions
Use window functions for rankings, running totals and period-over-period change
Build a monthly revenue report that a finance team can rely on

courses.title: Machine learning in production
courses.subtitle: Take models from a notebook to a monitored service, and keep them working once real users depend on them.
highlights: Explain what changes when a model moves from a notebook to production
Package a model with a reproducible environment and serve it behind an API
Prevent train–serve skew with shared feature code
Choose evaluation metrics that reflect the real cost of errors
Monitor data drift and model performance after launch
Roll out new models with shadow and canary releases, and roll back quickly

courses.title: Python for data engineering
courses.subtitle: Build data pipelines that are readable, testable and safe to run again, with Python and pandas.
highlights: Structure a pipeline project with configuration kept out of the code
Read and write files safely and handle time zones correctly
Clean, join and aggregate data with pandas
Validate data before it reaches your warehouse
Design idempotent loads that are safe to re-run
Add logging and retries so failures are visible and recoverable

courses.title: AWS cloud practitioner bootcamp
courses.subtitle: Understand the core AWS services, security model and pricing, and prepare for the Cloud Practitioner exam.
highlights: Explain cloud computing, Regions and Availability Zones in plain language
Describe the shared responsibility model and apply it to real services
Choose between core compute, storage and networking services
Set up IAM users, roles and policies with least privilege
Estimate costs and control spending with budgets and the right pricing model

courses.title: Power BI for business reporting
courses.subtitle: Turn spreadsheets and databases into clear, trustworthy reports your team will actually open.
highlights: Import and shape data with Power Query
Model data as a star schema with fact and dimension tables
Write DAX measures and understand filter context
Use time intelligence for year-to-date and year-on-year figures
Design a report page that answers its main question in seconds

courses.title: Cybersecurity essentials for teams
courses.subtitle: Practical habits that stop the most common attacks, for everyone in your organisation, not just IT.
highlights: Recognise phishing emails, messages and calls
Protect accounts with a password manager and multi-factor authentication
Keep laptops and phones updated, encrypted and locked
Handle personal and confidential data in line with good practice and Indian law
Report a suspected incident quickly, with the right information
